item.title: perf(ci): overlap two tsgo graphs inside each test-type stripe
item.summary: perf(ci): overlap two tsgo graphs inside each test-type stripe Each graph is a serial single-project build, so tsgo gains little past four cores; run 31852071103 measured ~34s/graph on 8 vCPU versus ~42s on hosted 4-core. Overlapping two fresh shard processes per CI stripe (--concurrency 2) uses the idle cores and roughly halves the stripe body; local runs keep the heap-bounded serial default.
